tips_en: Read paper 3 first because its execution-grounded trajectory synthesis and parent-normalized SFT provide a broadly reusable recipe for training agents, supported by consistent gains across model scales. Paper 2 is the natural next read: both rely on curated trajectories, but it focuses on adaptive multi-agent workflow generation and re-orchestration. Paper 1 broadens the theme from tool-use workflows to persistent, intent-aware video agents, emphasizing memory, evolving intent, and intervention timing.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文3：其基于执行结果的轨迹合成与父级归一化 SFT 提供了一套可广泛复用的智能体训练方法，并在不同模型规模上取得稳定增益。接着读论文2，它同样依赖精炼轨迹，但重点转向让主智能体动态生成并重编排多智能体工作流。论文1则将主题从工具调用扩展到持续、意图感知的视频智能体，突出记忆、动态意图与干预时机。
